name: TypeScript
summary: AI tools are fine, even for a fully agent-written patch, if you read and understand it and disclose it in the PR description. Bulk, queue-driven autonomous agent PRs and automated comments or summaries are not accepted.

evidence.quote: We have no objection to contributors using AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar).
provided you have read the result, you understand it, and you are prepared to discuss and revise it in review like any other contributor. However, we ask that you disclose this in the PR description.
We do not accept, under any circumstances, bulk, agent-driven contributions
Automated comments (e.g. posting auto-generated PR or issue "summaries") are not allowed and will result in an immediate block for inauthentic activity.
